newsitem.title: INDIA: India Wyeth up 3.3 pct ahead of meeting. [CORRECTED 08:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: India Wyeth up 3.3 pct ahead of meeting. [CORRECTED 08:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and throughout to show stock rose.)
Shares of Indian drug firm, Wyeth Laboratories traded higher at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Tuesday ahead of the company's board meeting, dealers said.
Wyeth gained 13.50 rupees, or 3.3 percent, to 423.50 rupees at the Bombay bourse in dull volume of 100 shares, they said.
The company is due to meet later on Tuesday to discuss an amalgamation with Cyanamid India Ltd.
Shares of Cyanamid India rose 1.25 rupees to 430.0 with over 2,000 shares traded at the Bombay bourse.
